proposed_comments.title: Report the missing caption in foreground recovery

confidence.rationale: The reachable empty-result branch throws a generic LINQ exception; exact-method synthetic controls verify the explicit assertion and preserved nonempty selection, and the affected project compiles.

proposed_comments.body:
### Report the missing caption in foreground recovery

**Severity:** `low`

If foreground recovery finds no visible caption matching the window title, `.First()` throws a generic sequence exception before the intended foreground assertion. Use the existing MSTest assertion pattern to report the target window and current foreground information, while leaving selection and clicking unchanged when a caption exists. If left unchanged, affected test failures are harder to diagnose; this is not a demonstrated product activation failure.

```suggestion
                .FirstOrDefault();
            Assert.IsNotNull(
                caption,
                $"'{window.WindowTitle}' has no visible caption for foreground recovery: {WindowControl.GetForegroundWindowInfo()}.");
```

The minimal replacement compiled with the affected test project. Synthetic controls using the exact method and real MSTest assertion verified the empty-caption diagnostic and preserved topmost-visible-caption selection. These checks do not exercise real foreground interaction or constitute full OOBE/product signoff.
